profile.name: MUHAMMAD ZAKI
profile.intro: A hands-on engineering graduate trained in rapid transit technology and mechanical servicing, with a practical approach to learning, troubleshooting and getting a fix right the first time.
profile.summary: Graduate of the Institute of Technical Education, holding a National ITE Certificate in Rapid Transit Technology and an ITE Skills Certificate in Mechanical Servicing, with internship experience at SMRT Corporation and NIPPON Express. Focused on equipment maintenance, workshop practice, workplace safety and following procedure carefully in a technical environment.

resume.summary: Technically trained candidate with an ITEC in Rapid Transit Technology and practical training in Mechanical Servicing, with a strong interest in mechanical maintenance and technical operations at SMRT. Brings internship exposure to mechanical and electrical (M&E) services, including equipment inspection and maintenance, BIM model familiarity, technical workflows, commissioning, and testing activities. Strong foundational skills in mechanical servicing, hand tools, workshop practices, basic troubleshooting, equipment inspection, and workplace safety. Demonstrates a methodical, procedure-focused approach with practical problem-solving, attention to detail, and readiness to support safe and reliable rail operations.

workExperience.summary: Part-time retail role focusing on customer service, sales, and store operations.
details: Provided excellent customer service and assisted with sales transactions.
Managed inventory levels and ensured products were properly displayed.
Supported daily store operations and performed administrative tasks.

workExperience.summary: Part-time operations role handling warehouse movement, dispatch prep and licensed forklift / reach-truck operation.
details: Warehouse logistics operations rely on the seamless integration of physical handling, inventory control, and communication. Personnel safely use heavy machinery like forklifts to move large goods, while also manually loading and unloading delivery vehicles.

To ensure order accuracy, items are carefully packaged, labeled, and prepared for shipping, while the warehouse tracking system is updated to maintain exact stock levels and proper storage conditions.
Finally, team members manage external relationships by answering inquiries and resolving issues for both customers and suppliers.

bullets: Assisted technicians with preventive maintenance on depot equipment safely daily

workExperience.summary: Six-month internship placement at SMRT supporting depot and engineering operations under technician supervision.
details: Rotated across two depot work areas to support scheduled preventive maintenance and corrective tasks, shadowing senior technicians and handling assigned hands-on work under direct supervision.

Used calibrated tooling for basic disassembly, inspection and reassembly of mechanical subsystems, and recorded each step clearly in the shared shift log so the next technician could pick up the work without guessing.
Took part in daily toolbox talks and weekly safety briefings, contributed near-miss observations, and completed the role with no safety incidents across the full placement.
